description: SUMO-RL provides SUMO reinforcement-learning environments for traffic-signal control. The provider is SUMO-RL project. Geographical and temporal coverage: The library supports Gymnasium single-agent and PettingZoo multi-agent interfaces and configurable states and rewards. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-sumo, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
